يختتمون (form VIII)
# يَخْتَتِمُونَ (yaḵtatimūna) /jax.ta.ti.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# يُخْتَتَمُونَ (yuḵtatamūna) /jux.ta.ta.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
